   240	/// The Kitty graphics protocol lets a program place an image with text.
   241	/// The program creates a virtual placement, which has no position of its
   242	/// own, and prints placeholder characters (U+10EEEE) where the image
   243	/// should appear. Each placeholder cell says which image it shows and
